tasks.title: Identify a replacement paddle
tasks.description: Locate the rooster-comb paddle and prepare a request that keeps its hardware and selling-unit questions.
tasks.requestHint: Confirm CMP-CS1002, Figure 2 item 85, for my CM-25 serial. I need the requested number entered separately, not automatically all twelve shown. Please confirm the supplied unit and separately invoiced required hardware.

tasks.title: Check what a main beater includes
tasks.description: Compare the main rotor with its separate paddles before asking what the replacement assembly supplies.
tasks.requestHint: Confirm CMP-CS10211 and whether the supplied main-beater assembly includes paddles, sleeves, bearings or hardware. Please avoid duplicating assembly contents as separate requested parts.
